claim(uint256[],bool[],bytes32[][],addre.details: Two paths, selected by `vault`:      - Direct (`vault == address(0)`): `claimant = msg.sender`. Each leaf is verified against        `msg.sender` and receipts are credited to `msg.sender`.      - Delegated (`vault != address(0)`): the caller must be an authorized delegate for        `vault` per delegate.xyz v2 — `checkDelegateForContract(msg.sender, vault, this, 0)`,        where `rights == bytes32(0)` matches both an "all" delegation and one scoped to this        contract. On success `claimant = vault`: leaves are verified against `vault` and        receipts are credited to `vault`, letting a hot wallet claim for the cold vault that        actually held the Normies at snapshot. Reverts `InvalidDelegation` if not authorized.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256).details: Returns how much royalty is owed and to whom, based on a sale price that may be denominated in any unit of exchange. The royalty amount is denominated and should be paid in that same unit of exchange.

setAutomaticApprovalOfTransfersFromValid.details: Throws when the caller is not the contract owner.

params.autoApprove: If true, the collection's transfer validator will be automatically approved to                    transfer holder's tokens.

Throws when provided validator contract is not the zero address and does not have code.Throws when the caller is not the contract owner.

Postconditions:

1. The transferValidator address is updated. 2. The `TransferValidatorUpdated` event is emitted.

params.transferValidator_: The address of the transfer validator contract.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claim(uint256[],bool[],bytes32[][],addre.notice: Create Phase 1 receipts for claimed Normies, each proven against the snapshot root.

getTransferValidationFunction().notice: Returns the function selector for the transfer validator's validation function to be called for transaction simulation.

getTransferValidator().notice: Returns the transfer validator contract address for this token contract.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).notice: Overrides behavior of isApprovedFor all such that if an operator is not explicitly approved         for all, the contract owner can optionally auto-approve the 721-C transfer validator for transfers.

reseal().notice: Restart the reveal window when the prior seal aged out of the 256-block blockhash         horizon (the practical case being the 14-day fallback, where the entropy blocks are         long unreadable by the time anyone calls reveal). Only moves `sealedAtBlock`; the         frozen receipt list is untouched.

reveal().notice: Permissionless reveal. Mixes the hashes of REVEAL_BLOCK_COUNT consecutive blocks         starting at `sealedAtBlock + REVEAL_DELAY_BLOCKS` into the seed. Callable once all         those blocks are mined (and far enough back that they're stable) but before the         blockhash window expires. Past expiry, reseal() must restart the window first.

sealForReveal().notice: Permissionless seal trigger for the fallback path. Freezes the receipt list so the         reveal window can begin. Auto-seal already fires inline when supply is exhausted via         mint/airdrop; this is the safety net if Phase 2 stalls below capacity — callable         once `phase1ClosedAt + FALLBACK_REVEAL_DELAY` has elapsed. Any remaining Phase 2         slots are stranded: after seal, no further mints or airdrops are accepted.

setAutomaticApprovalOfTransfersFromValid.notice: Sets if the transfer validator is automatically approved as an operator for all token owners.

setTransferValidator(address).notice: Sets the transfer validator for the token contract.
